Card Q&A.a: It refers to when there are 2 or more cards with the same level among all of the stacked cards. Examples include when a level 5 Digimon has a level 5 digivolution card or when a level 6 Digimon has 2 level 5 digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards" mean, exactly?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.

[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon with 2 or more same-level cards in its stack attacks, by suspending this Tamer, digivolve it into a Digimon card with the [Night Claw], [Light Fang], [Galaxy] or [CS] trait in the trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
